rule_or_requirement: A faster launch must preserve a pixel-only finite three-action package and retain the qualified-finish objective.
observable_information: Four grayscale observations, image road centers and speed, obstacle diagnostic, and base controller action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve the exact one-shot launch gate, then apply fixed pixel bend preview steering and speed-coupled bend braking through existing wrappers.
expected_success_endpoint: An exact local ZIP with immutable source and package hashes for separate matched driving evaluation.
falsifier: Package fails source, import, static, runtime, or action constraints; composition fails to activate on visible bends.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Build one exact local ZIP and compare against exact launch-only ZIP on registered cells.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local packaging profile with a 600-second limit and 500 MB ZIP limit; no driving, training, site upload, official submission, or model confirmation in this run.
